What was the most fun day or night of your life?

This is probably a pretty boring one, but I went to see La Dispute live, the band asked everyone to turn off their phones and actually enjoy the show. The crowd was amazing, everyone was friendly, there was no barrier between the stage and the mosh. They played King Park and I just felt so connected to everyone in the room, it was definitely the most fun night.

First day working for the circus. Almost got ran over by an elephant. Here's that story:

A three-ring circus actually marks out all three rings with a series of interlocking, curved, painted fiberglass pieces over a large round mat. When the elephants come to play, you have to open up holes in those rings large enough for them to fit through, because the elephant will crush or trip over them. Since the lead elephant usually has a rider, tripping could be catastrophic. My first show was in Portland, Oregon. The music is blaring, the crowd is screaming, the announcer is yelling, and I'm taking my cues visually from the "prop team" (whom the rigging manager supervises during shows). I open the rings, but I'm in a hurry and instead of sliding the one fiberglass piece atop the other, I accidentally knock it over. Being my first day, I want to get everything perfect so i go back to fix it. My back is to the tiger cage which, now empty, has also been opened in the same fashion and currently has three large pachyderms barreling through it right at me. The entire prop team start running my direction yelling and swinging their arms wildly, and I think I must have knocked something else out of position, so instead of getting out of the way I start looking around at the rigging to make sure I haven't dislodged anything important. It isn't until the very last second that I sense more than hear or see the approaching animal. I do a jump and a mid-air 180. The leg that hit me was that of the rider, rather than the elephant. Fortunately for me, because I've seen an elephant kick a steel cage clear across an oval raceway!
Love it when you talk about your time there! Why do you not talk about it more? It sounds like it was so much fun!

Well, in person no-one ever believes me, or they think I just pulled my dick out and they start a pissing contest. Unless you knew me at the time, I have no proof to show you that I was there, and for some reason telling people about how you've pet Bengal Tigers make guys very defensive. ::shrug::

Online, ... well now that I think about it I guess it's the same two things. Disbelief, and trolls. It ruins the good time of telling a fond memory when you spend the next few hours having to defend yourself for it.
